messages:
Janet (docs): I opened a PR to update the model-catalog entry for 'fulcrum-lite-quant' — deprecate flag, replace embed example, and fix the sequence limits table. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/498

Ravi (ml-infra): On it. We changed quant profiles last month; the perf numbers in the existing card are stale. I can run a quick bench on A100 and post updated token/sec numbers tomorrow.

Janet (docs): Thanks. If you can include the exact command you used that helps for reproducibility.

Leo (runtime): Note: fulcrum-lite-quant relies on the new kv-cache layout introduced in runtime 1.15. Add a compatibility note: "Runtime >= 1.15 required for optimal performance; older runtimes will fallback to slower kernels."

Sam (sdk): Also saw the generate -> embeddings mixup. Proposing these snippets:

Python: `resp = client.embeddings.create(model=\"fulcrum-embed-1\", input=[\"test\"])`
JS: `const r = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'fulcrum-embed-1', input: ['test'] })`

Janet (docs): I'll swap those in. Can we also add a short migration blurb: "If you relied on fulcrum-lite-quant for embeddings via generate, migrate to fulcrum-embed-1 or use embeddings endpoint"?

Ivy (cs): Heads-up — we have ~5 Dedicated tenants still on fulcrum-lite-quant. Please include a deprecation window and tag CS for outreach before publishing. Suggested copy: "Deprecated 2026-05-15; unsupported after 2026-08-15. Contact support for extended access."

Janet (docs): Adding that now and tagging @Ivy (cs) on the PR.

Ravi (ml-infra): Quick bench results: A100, context 8k, batch 1 -> 430 tok/s (old card: 395 tok/s). Command: `./bench --model fulcrum-lite-quant --profile quant-v2 --ctx 8192 --batch 1`. Pushed logs to PR comments.

Leo (runtime): Added the runtime requirement and a note that fallback to non-fused kernels increases latency ~2-4x.

Sam (sdk): CI linkcheck failed on one internal anchor. I'll open a tiny follow-up commit to fix.

ci-bot: docs/linkcheck failed (1 broken link)

Janet (docs): Thanks — once link fix is in and CI passes I'll merge and coordinate with CS for the email. Anything else?

Ravi (ml-infra): LGTM for numbers.

Leo (runtime): LGTM runtime wording.

Ivy (cs): LGTM — will prepare outreach draft once PR merges.

Sam (sdk): Link fix pushed, re-running CI.

ci-bot: docs/linkcheck re-run queued by Sam (sdk).

Janet (docs): Great, thanks everyone — merging once green.
